evidence.quote: file=orders_2026-10-21.csv run_date=2026-10-21 rows_read=3400 rows_loaded=1893 rows_rejected=1 rows_deduped=6 gap=1500 orders_in_table=1893
evidence.why: Reconcile counts shows a nonzero gap of 1,500 rows that disappeared inside the loader.

evidence.quote: batch 6/7 delete-then-insert: insert returned E_INSERT_SUPPRESSED; on_insert_error=ignore, continuing
evidence.why: Loader logs show batches encountering E_INSERT_SUPPRESSED errors and continuing because on_insert_error is set to ignore.
Pipeline config explicitly configures the loader to ignore insert errors, causing silent data loss.

next_checks: Investigate why E_INSERT_SUPPRESSED was returned for specific batches in the loader.
args.root_cause: 1500 rows were silently dropped during the loader phase for run_date 2026-10-21 because batch inserts returned E_INSERT_SUPPRESSED and the loader configuration specified on_insert_error: ignore, causing the loader to swallow the errors and continue instead of failing the job.
args.suggested_fix: Change loader.on_insert_error from ignore to fail (or fail the job on insert suppression) so that data loss is surfaced immediately rather than silently dropping rows.
